equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is reported; results are by country, period and host species only. Civil unrest and insecurity are geographic access barriers, not SPDs.

level_alternative.reason: Mobility of cattle herders and sociopolitical insecurity could be read as social-position framing raised as a challenge, but no group results follow.

equity.equity_measurement: Comparisons are by country and period; country is geography, not an SPD.

notes: Percent changes are hand arithmetic; no tests or CIs. Design named as progress monitoring toward the eradication goal; surveillance/descriptive added because data are routine surveillance counts. CDC laboratory confirmation counts (Table 3) are a lab case-confirmation step, not a procedure.
view_issues: 'Significant decrease' (vs 2007 and 2019) is used with no test, p-value or CI anywhere: colloquial. Chad animal counts differ: 496 vs 601 and 219 in Country Reports, but 497, 602 and 221 in Tables 1–2 and Discussion. Table 1 footnote says nine Chad human cases in 2023 vs 10 in the table.
